newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway c.bank says sold 1.96 bln NOK last Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Norway c.bank says sold 1.96 bln NOK last Tuesday.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Monday it sold a net 1.96 billion crowns last Tuesday, the day it cut interest rates to keep the crown from appreciating too much.
The bank said in a brief statement it sold 897 million crowns last Monday and 1.96 billion crowns last Tuesday.
The statement gave no explanation, but the bank frequently intervenes, buying and selling currency to keep the Norwegian crown stable.
The bank has sold a net 67.86 billion crowns so far this year.
The bank last Tuesday announced it was cutting its key interest rates, effective on Wednesday, to rein in the strong crown.

The bank trimmed its overnight deposit rate, the credit rate, to 4.0 percent from 4.50 percent. The overnight lending rate, charged to commercial and savings banks, was reduced to 6.0 percent from 6.50 percent.
